reviewed_properties: A newer wallet preparation closes current review and takes shared generation ownership.
Close, expiry invalidation and any new review invalidate pending wallet preparation replies across payment/transfer and buy/sell review surfaces.
Generation is checked after JSON decoding, covering delayed headers and delayed JSON success/failure; outer errors update feedback only while generation still owns preparation.
Wallet signing callbacks byte-identical to baseline; preparation request endpoints, bodies and headers unchanged.
Rollout allows only five named functions and exact generation declaration; candidate digest, preimage metadata and file/runtime inventories verified before atomic replacement.
Rollback requires verified matching backup plan, digest and metadata; post-write failures retain preimage and permit explicit reconciliation or rollback.

Browser runner loads exact HTML into an intercepted .invalid origin; blocks service workers and other origins, allows only synthetic wallet preparation POSTs, records unexpected same-origin writes, and always rejects wallet signing.

Browser uses native DOM/fetch with deferred route fulfillment, 320/390 widths, all transfer/payment pairings and cancel/Escape/ordering/stale transport failure/replacement/expiry modes. JSON-body stalls and actual buy/sell replacements are separately covered in deterministic tests, not claimed as native browser cases.
Recorded isolated supervisor reports nobody, Chromium sandbox, PrivateNetwork, ProtectHome, process exit zero and stopped/empty cgroup.
Prepared plan pins reviewed candidate and 56 installed inputs; full host state validation executes again at apply.

tests.name: Node existing wallet_review action transfer/payment x confirm/cancel/escape/expiry
isolated local rollout apply/reconcile/rollback and two scope rejection checks
pytest wallet preparation, recipient review behavior and exchange review UI
Reviewed recorded native browser cases and matching source/runner hashes

limitations: Local rollout rehearsal mocks runtime/public GET and modifies temporary files only; host/public preflight and deployment remain root agent responsibilities.
Cancellation during already-started wallet signing is a separate existing roadmap item outside this preparation-only review.
